items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: I go and see my buddy over there and we have a few drinks. He lived just across the street from the bar and grill, and we'd sit there and talk, talk about an hour and a half, few drinks.

ctx.x: This was when you were at Small's Paradise (unintelligible)?
That's right. (Unintelligible), Oh, Ward Pinkett quite a few. He picked guys up (unintelligible).
Ward Pinkett No, I didn't, you knew him?
